verdict.rationale: Grafana OSS plus Loki/Tempo/Mimir are documented as self-hostable with provisioning-as-code and GitOps support, and community reports confirm large-scale self-hosted production use (cryogenic-fridge-to-cloud monitoring). Some upgrade-path documentation exists (Loki migrate/upgrade docs), but there's no single documented end-to-end architecture/upgrade guide for the full stack, and community feedback notes growing operational complexity from needing to run multiple additional services (Alertmanager, etc.) to get full functionality. Missing for 10: a unified documented architecture diagram and upgrade path covering the whole stack (not just Loki), and stronger independent corroboration that upgrades across the full stack are smooth in production.
